requiredGates.question: Who owns this state or decision?
What happens when events arrive together, late, repeated, or out of order?
Do provisioned platforms, web clients, and backend interpret the same contract, and are unprovisioned targets explicitly identified?
Does the behavior remain correct across sockets, cache, auth, rate limits, storage, and retries?
Does CI certify the exact artifact and configuration that will be installed or deployed?
What behavior remains unprovable without the real device or runtime?
